# Data licence

## Records generated by the network

Records generated by the network are dedicated to the public domain under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

This covers:

- round manifests
- manifest log checkpoints
- consensus states
- indexes

To the extent possible under law, the authors have waived all copyright and related or neighbouring rights to these records.

## Source data

Source data, including raw responses and canonical forms of source records, is not covered by CC0. It remains under its source's own licence. The licence and attribution wording for each source is recorded in `docs/DESIGN.md`.
